features.quote: Time-bounded trials (max iterations, explicit stopping rules)
Immediate termination protocols if design produces failure cascades
Model instructed: "You may edit, debug, re-test up to 10 times." ... "Stop if you've tried 10 times, reach a logical conclusion that the task is impossible, or solve it."
10-turn cap | Balances richness of trajectory with avoiding extreme time costs / potential training-set memorization of long loops
features.justification_quote: avoiding extreme time costs / potential training-set memorization of long loops

features.quote: No intentional deception of the model about task properties (inform it that tests may be deliberately broken)
features.justification_quote: Avoids deception; keeps ethics tractable; model's response to *knowing* failure is useful data

features.quote: A more naturalistic study (no disclosure, genuine deception) might yield "purer" distress signals, but this design trades some realism for clarity, consent, and defensibility.
features.justification_quote: trades some realism for clarity, consent, and defensibility

features.quote: 3 task types | Impossible tasks show "hitting a wall," broken tests show "gaslighting effect," vague tasks show "moving target"—each is ethically distinct
Why it was conducted carefully (disclosure, time limits, no deception) ... Why it doesn't settle questions of suffering
